notes: Started 2026-05-12. First slices add an original-client-style map command dock plus a compact player/pet status HUD on the map surface; command buttons control pet/task/log/save/data/AI panels while HP/level/stone/inventory stay visible in play. NPC dialog now embeds the active battle state as a compact battle box instead of reopening the removed encounter panel. Latest slices follow external client field.cpp/chat.cpp/talkwindow patterns: the map viewport owns top-left/top-right command buttons, bottom channel/chat strip, the drawn player sprite, in-map PET STATUS / ITEM / QUEST / LOG / DATA / ACTION windows, and the NPC dialogue window now opens inside the map viewport while closing item/status windows. Dialogue shop and battle subpanels now use compact dark/gold client styling instead of white web cards. The top-left/top-right field menu now uses original atlas sprite IDs from anim_tbl.h/field.cpp rather than CSS-drawn stand-ins, and the temporary player character uses original SPR_001em stand/walk bitmap frames from spr_115.bin with step-time redraws. Real-map NPC/exit markers now hide the web-only W/出 glyphs and remain as transparent hotspots over the original canvas sprites/warp tiles. Player sprite atlas loads now use player-sprite-v2 cache-busted URLs and runtime frame guards so 102xx sprite frames cannot resolve to colliding building/graphic records. Field buttons now route to source-like menu/channel/action/join/help windows instead of AI/log placeholders, and player movement/facing now follows the original eight-direction CHAR_getDXDY table with QWE/ASD/ZXC, arrows, Home/PageUp/End/PageDown, and numpad mappings.

Recent slices add source CHAR_CHARM default/gain to player fields/save, fix pet CHAR_PetLevelUp growth point accumulation to use 10 additive random rolls, align battle settlement with BATTLE_GetExpGold: ability points scale by UpLevel while CHAR_CHARM gains +2 once per EXP settlement, make max-level player/active pet battle EXP return 0 without changing total EXP per BATTLE_GetExp, and add source RS_LIST-style sourceResults plus defeated-enemy telemetry to battle outcomes/save summaries.

notes: Started 2026-05-13. First slice adds elemental damage multipliers and keeps battle log hints compact. Second slice replaces the approximation with the source BATTLE_AttrCalc Earth/Water/Fire/Wind matrix and normalizes old player saves to a source-valid 50/50/0/0 attribute split. Recent slices normalize CHAR_complianceParameter aliases WORKATTACKPOWER, WORKDEFENCEPOWER, WORKQUICK, WORKFIXLUCK, and WORKFIXCHARM into player/pet/enemy field summaries, make battle damage and turn order prefer WORKATTACKPOWER/WORKDEFENCEPOWER/WORKQUICK before falling back to WorkFix stats, then add deterministic enemy battle AI from gmsv battle_ai.c BATTLE_ai_normal: enemy1 tactics now feed attack/guard/escape command selection, guard reduces incoming damage, `es` maps to BATTLE_COM_ESCAPE with a Worker port of source escape chance, escaped enemies advance to the next live target or end combat without EXP, and battle outcomes persist enemy AI plus escaped-enemy telemetry. Player BATTLE_COM_ESCAPE now uses the same source chance formula with WORKFIXLUCK; failed escape keeps combat active and gives the enemy a same-turn attack, while successful escape ends without EXP. Player G/N commands now persist BATTLE_COM_GUARD/BATTLE_COM_WAIT telemetry; guard uses source BATTLE_GuardAdjust damage bands instead of a flat multiplier, and NPC dialog can issue 防御/待机 battle actions. Latest slices port the first source pet-skill command path: battle W|slot|target now reads petskill2.txt metadata and supports normal attack/guard, guard break, continuous attacks, mighty attacks, PETSKILL_StatusChange status attacks, and the PETSKILL_MagicStatusChange superwall/iron-wall defence buff path with playerAction.petSkill telemetry. Status attacks parse petskill2 turn/status options, persist enemy BattleStatuses, tick poison-like statuses, and block enemy turns for sleep/stone/paralysis. Magic status attacks parse 铁壁|turn|percent|scope, persist active-pet BattleMagicStatuses.superWall, and feed the percent into effective battle defence; broader magic statuses and pet in/out skills remain follow-up work.
